title: Schauberger devices that reportedly took off

tellings.quote: there are also some sort of pretty arcane stories about things that Schauberger had built that reportedly took off

plain: In the 1940s, in Austria and Czechoslovakia, an inventor named Viktor Schauberger supposedly built machines that "reportedly took off" and flew. The researcher Nick Cook passes this on without a source, calling them "pretty arcane stories." If true, it would mean flying machines of an unusual kind were being built during that decade.
